context: A boss briefs his secretary on a policy update memo
purpose: Teach: 判明/改定/答申/定年/発足/定める/出力/分割

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 佐藤君、人事制度の改定について、審議会の答申がやっと出たよ。
lines.en: Sato, the council's report on the HR system revision has finally come out.
lines.style: Boss delivers news with measured, authoritative tone

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: お疲れ様です。例の定年延長の件も、そこで判明したんですか？
lines.en: Thank you for your work. Was the retirement age extension also clarified there?
lines.style: Polite secretary responds with attentive professional curiosity

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ああ、新しい定年は六十五歳と定める方針だ。来年四月に新制度が発足する。
lines.en: Yes, the new retirement age will be set at sixty-five. The new system launches next April.
lines.style: Boss states policy details with firm executive clarity

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: なるほど。では人事システムから関連データを出力して、社内メモにまとめましょうか。
lines.en: I see. Shall I output the relevant data from the HR system and compile it into an internal memo?
lines.style: Secretary confirms next steps in efficient business register

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 頼む。ただし内容が長いから、概要編と詳細編に分割してくれ。
lines.en: Please do. But since the content is long, split it into a summary and a detailed version.
lines.style: Boss issues practical instructions with concise managerial style

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 承知いたしました。給与規定の改定部分も、別紙にまとめておきますね。
lines.en: Understood. I'll also compile the salary regulation revisions on a separate sheet.
lines.style: Secretary acknowledges with proactive and organized confidence

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 助かるよ。役員会で配るから、夕方までに印刷まで終わらせておいてくれ。
lines.en: That helps. We'll distribute it at the board meeting, so finish the printing by evening.
lines.style: Boss expresses appreciation while reinforcing the deadline
